dedupe_keys.name: roof3d aerial imagery dsm and lod2 roof plane ground truth for building reconstruction

description: Roof3D is a benchmark dataset for segmenting individual buildings and their LoD2 roof planes with deep learning, pairing aerial imagery and elevation models with instance ground truth. It was published on Zenodo by Philipp Schuegraf of the German Aerospace Center (DLR); version 3, of April 2024, contains the test area as a whole with 3D ground truth. Files are an RGB aerial image, a digital surface model and a digital terrain model of a test area (file names begin 'koeln'), and a ground-truth raster of building instances and roof planes. Coverage: one test area, which the file names suggest is in Cologne. Access: four GeoTIFF files of about 12 to 16 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the record is brief and a single test area limits generalisation. Simulation uses: training and testing automatic LoD2 roof reconstruction for 3D city models and rooftop solar or roof-load studies. Related records: LoD2-Former and the DLR rooftop and agri-PV suitability maps.
name: Roof3D: aerial imagery, DSM and LoD2 roof plane ground truth for building reconstruction
